# App is focused (`app_focused`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Apps · **Available in:** personal automations

True when one of the apps currently has the active window.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | app or list of apps | yes |  | App patterns. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: app_focused
    app: code.exe
```
